### Executive Summary
Citrix NetScaler appliances are reportedly experiencing repeated reboots after the deployment of a security update designed to patch a zero-day vulnerability. The issue was documented on October 3, 2026.

The situation impacts environments relying on affected Citrix NetScaler hardware or virtual appliances, as the unexpected reboot cycle disrupts normal traffic processing and network services.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause
The primary technical impact is appliance instability, causing affected Citrix NetScaler units to reboot repeatedly following the installation of the zero-day patch. This operational disruption prevents sustained device uptime.

The root cause is directly associated with the application of the specific zero-day security update. Further technical details regarding the underlying code execution or trigger conditions leading to the reboot loop are not yet confirmed.
